bias.en: Downtrend · broke $326.8, lowest close since March
bias.zh: 下跌趋势 · 跌破 $326.8，收盘创 3月以来新低

read.en: TSMC fell 9.5% on Nov 20 to $318.71, its lowest close since Mar 30, trading $318.48–343.75 on heavy volume (2.38x the 20-day average). It is below the 5-day ($353.3), 10-day ($376.9), 30-day ($403.3) and 100-day ($420.5), all falling, and the rising 200-day ($403.6). MACD has been below its signal since Nov 16, below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 17 ($411.77), and RSI is 28.3, oversold.
read.zh: 台积电 11月20日下跌 9.5%，收于 $318.71，为 3月30日以来最低收盘，盘中区间 $318.48–343.75，成交放量（为 20 日均量的 2.38 倍）。股价位于 5 日（$353.3）、10 日（$376.9）、30 日（$403.3）和 100 日均线（$420.5）下方，均在下行，并低于上行的 200 日均线（$403.6）。MACD 自 11月16日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图放大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月17日起看空（$411.77），RSI 为 28.3，处于超卖区。

read.en: The drop broke all three written supports, $351.2 (Nov 5 and 19 lows), $340 (early-April lows) and $326.8 (Apr 2 low), now resistance. Resistance is $319–325.7 (February, March and January lows), then $326.8–333 and $338.6–343.8. Support is $313.8–318.5 (Nov 20, Mar 30 and Jan 8 lows), then $307.3–311.4 (October 2025 highs) and $292.9. A close above $325.7 would target $327–333; below $313.8, $307–311.
